hypothesis: Fuse local target extraction, shifted predicted contribution, exponent generation, and denominator accumulation into one row-wise kernel to reduce local launch and temporary coordination overhead while preserving caller collectives.
scope: local_prepare_fp16_stream only; local max remains a separate stage

correctness.predicted_local: shifted target logit only when the target belongs to this rank, otherwise zero
correctness.target_local: target minus rank * local_vocab when owned

collectives: caller preserves exactly one MAX all-reduce and two SUM all-reduces
compatibility: CUDA 11.8, V100 sm_70; finite initializer avoids CUDART_INF_F
